correctness.rationale: The exact closed-neighborhood system over F2 is c_(j-1)+Bc_j+c_(j+1)=0, B=I+A(P6). Its characteristic polynomial is (x^3+x+1)^2; the Fibonacci-polynomial recurrence has f9(B)=0 and coprime residues for f1 through f8, hence exactly the n+1 divisible by 9 kernels are six-dimensional. T^9=diag(B^7,B^7) and boundary reflections replicate eight-column weights q times when n+1=9q. The complete independently checked 64-first-column table gives coefficients 1,4,12,12,3,12,15,4,1 at weights 0,18,20,22,24,26,28,30,36. New independent GF2 elimination reconstructed the whole kernels for n=1..27, including n=8,17,26. The finite table is exhaustively 64 cases; all-n statement follows from symbolic recurrence, not finite extrapolation.
